$comment: FICTIONAL /api/summary response for demo/inputs/marcia-prepare.json, hand-written for UI tests (T-13). jam is outputMode simple_english (v0.3 A5), so the user version is first-person simple English. Static fields copied from content/*/en.json.

english.mainConcern: Pain in both knees for about two months, worse in the right knee. Finding it hard to walk up stairs.

duration.text: About two months (started 1 to 6 months ago)

english.frequencyAndPattern: Comes and goes. Worse in the morning when first getting up.
changesAndTriggers: Hurts more when rain is coming.
Gets stiff after sitting for a long time.
Tries to walk a little every day.
worriesAndBarriers: Worried about being told to stop work.
Does not always understand when the doctor talks fast.
questionsToAsk: What could be causing the pain in my knees, and how will we find out?
Is it okay to keep taking paracetamol the way I do now?
What can I do to make the stairs easier?
What should I do if it gets worse before my next appointment?
Could you please speak a little slower so I can follow?
whatToBring: The paracetamol box and the cream from the pharmacy.
A note of which days the pain is worse.
notMentioned: You didn't mention what makes it better.
